key: Well, well. We don't get many new faces around here.
en: Well, well. We don't get many new faces around here.
ja: おやおや。ここいらじゃ　新顔なんて　めったに　見ねぇな。

key: Just call me Bouffalant Bill.
en: Just call me Bouffalant Bill.
ja: バッフロンビルと　呼んでくれ。

key: You need anythin', I just might be able to hook you on up.
en: You need anythin', I just might be able to hook you on up.
ja: 何か　必要なら　都合を　つけられるかも　しれねぇぜ。

key: Ain' no shortage of odds and ends we been salvaged from the supply trains 'round here.
en: Ain' no shortage of odds and ends we been salvaged from the supply trains 'round here.
ja: このあたりの　補給列車から　救い出してきた　がらくたなら　いくらでも　あるからな。

key: Gimme a holler if you wanna see what I got.
en: Gimme a holler if you wanna see what I got.
ja: 何が　あるか　見たけりゃ　声を　かけてくれ。

key: BOUFFALANT BILL: You wanna know how I got my name?
en: BOUFFALANT BILL: You wanna know how I got my name?
ja: バッフロンビル: この名前の　由来　知りたいか?

key: Well, it's kind of a long story, but I'll just say this--
en: Well, it's kind of a long story, but I'll just say this--
ja: まあ　ちいと　長い話に　なるが　こう言っとくぜ――

key: It involves a herd of Bouffalant, a high speed tractor, and the real reason the old Railnet had to be shut down.
en: It involves a herd of Bouffalant, a high speed tractor, and the real reason the old Railnet had to be shut down.
ja: バッフロンの群れと　高速トラクターと　昔の鉄道網が　閉鎖された本当の理由が　絡んでてな。

key: Heh. I ain't allowed in Reborn City no more after that.
en: Heh. I ain't allowed in Reborn City no more after that.
ja: へへ。それ以来　オレは　リボーンシティに　入れねぇんだ。

key: Anyway, you here to buy somethin' or what?
en: Anyway, you here to buy somethin' or what?
ja: ともかく　何か　買いに　来たのか?

key: BOUFFALANT BILL: Money don't do you too much good out here. Might as well buy somethin'!
en: BOUFFALANT BILL: Money don't do you too much good out here. Might as well buy somethin'!
ja: バッフロンビル: ここじゃ　金なんて　あんまり　役に立たねぇ。だったら　何か　買っちまいな!

key: Hey there, welcome to Train Town!
en: Hey there, welcome to Train Town!
ja: よう　トレインタウンへ　ようこそ!

key: Name's Alduous. Al for short is fine.
en: Name's Alduous. Al for short is fine.
ja: 名前は　アルドス。アルって　呼んでくれて　いいぜ。

key: I suppose you already met my wife, Europa?
en: I suppose you already met my wife, Europa?
ja: 女房の　エウロパには　もう会ったか?

key: The two of us got a little stir-crazy cooped up in the city, so we decided to hoof it out here and see what kind of adventure we could make.
en: The two of us got a little stir-crazy cooped up in the city, so we decided to hoof it out here and see what kind of adventure we could make.
ja: 二人とも　街に　閉じこもってて　うんざりしちまってな　それで　ここまで　歩いてきて　どんな冒険が　できるか　見てみることに　したんだ。

key: In the end, we never wanted to go back.
en: In the end, we never wanted to go back.
ja: 結局　もう　戻る気には　なれなかった。

key: Over time we've picked up a few stragglers here and there-- mostly people lookin' to escape the city themselves.
en: Over time we've picked up a few stragglers here and there-- mostly people lookin' to escape the city themselves.
ja: 時が経つにつれて　あちこちから　はぐれ者たちを　拾ってきてな―― たいていは　街から　逃げ出したい　連中だ。

key: For instance, Miss Percy?
en: For instance, Miss Percy?
ja: たとえば　パーシーさんとかな?

key: We found her collapsed out in the desert.
en: We found her collapsed out in the desert.
ja: 砂漠で　倒れてるところを　見つけたんだ。

key: Apparently her husband had sworn to kill her if she stepped foot outside one more time.
en: Apparently her husband had sworn to kill her if she stepped foot outside one more time.
ja: 旦那が　もう一度　外に　足を踏み出したら　殺すって　誓ってたらしくてな。

key: So she ran to somewhere he'd never find her.
en: So she ran to somewhere he'd never find her.
ja: それで　絶対に　見つからないような場所まで　逃げてきたんだ。

key: And sometimes there's that kid wanderin' around too. He's a strange one.
en: And sometimes there's that kid wanderin' around too.  He's a strange one.
ja: それと　たまに　あの子も　あたりを　うろついてるな。ありゃ　変わってる。

key: Anyway, I hope you'll make yourself at home here.
en: Anyway, I hope you'll make yourself at home here.
ja: ともかく　ここで　くつろいでいってくれ。

key: If you need anything, you let my wife or I know.
en: If you need anything, you let my wife or I know.
ja: 何か　必要なら　女房か　オレに　声を　かけてくれ。

key: ALDUOUS: By the way, if you're out here, I don't suppose you're looking for the Gym, are you?
en: ALDUOUS: By the way, if you're out here, I don't suppose you're looking for the Gym, are you?
ja: アルドス: ところで　ここに　来たってことは　ジムを　探してるんじゃ　ないか?

key: Hate to disappoint, but despite the pattern marked outside, this isn't it.
en: Hate to disappoint, but despite the pattern marked outside, this isn't it.
ja: がっかりさせて　悪いが　外に　模様が　描いてあっても　ここじゃ　ねぇんだ。

key: Miss Titania used to run challenges out here, but...
en: Miss Titania used to run challenges out here, but...
ja: 昔は　ティタニアの嬢ちゃんが　ここで　挑戦を　受け付けてたんだが……

key: Well, you should go a little farther. You'll see.
en: Well, you should go a little farther. You'll see.
ja: まあ　もう少し　先まで　行ってみな。わかるはずだ。

key: Um... Hello. Can I help you?
en: Um... Hello. Can I help you?
ja: あの……　こんにちは。何か　ご用でしょうか?

key: Y-you weren't sent here by anyone, right?
en: Y-you weren't sent here by anyone, right?
ja: だ　誰かに　ここへ　送られてきた　わけじゃ　ないですよね?

key: You're not looking for me and don't know who I am, right?
en: You're not looking for me and don't know who I am, right?
ja: わたしを　探してるわけでも　わたしが　誰か　知ってるわけでも　ないですよね?

key: ...Oh, thank goodness.
en: ...Oh, thank goodness.
ja: ……ああ　よかった。

key: I'm sorry-- I just get so nervous when new people come here.
en: I'm sorry-- I just get so nervous when new people come here.
ja: ごめんなさい――　新しい人が　来ると　どうしても　緊張してしまって。

key: I worry that they might be from that guy...
en: I worry that they might be from that guy...
ja: あの人から　来た人かもって　心配に　なるんです……

key: But if you don't know who I'm talking about, then no problem, right?
en: But if you don't know who I'm talking about, then no problem, right?
ja: でも　わたしが　誰のことを　言ってるか　わからないなら　問題　ないですよね?

key: Just, don't tell anyone you met me here, okay?
en: Just, don't tell anyone you met me here, okay?
ja: ただ　ここで　わたしに　会ったこと　誰にも　言わないでくださいね?

key: My name's Persephone, but, please just call me Percy.
en: My name's Persephone, but, please just call me Percy.
ja: わたしの名前は　ペルセフォネですけど　パーシーって　呼んでください。

key: Umm, I'm probably not much use to you, but if you're staying a while, maybe speak to Europa?
en: Umm, I'm probably not much use to you, but if you're staying a while, maybe speak to Europa?
ja: あの　わたしは　たぶん　あまり　お役に立てませんけど　しばらく　ここに　いるなら　エウロパに　話しかけてみては?

key: She's kind of our leader here.
en: She's kind of our leader here.
ja: 彼女が　ここの　まとめ役　みたいな人なので。

key: MISS PERCY: It's tough living out here. Sometimes we have hardly any food or drink to go on.
en: MISS PERCY: It's tough living out here. Sometimes we have hardly any food or drink to go on.
ja: パーシー: ここでの暮らしは　大変です。食べ物や飲み物が　ほとんどないときも　あります。

key: But I think that just makes us appreciate what we do get even more.
en: But I think that just makes us appreciate what we do get even more.
ja: でも　だからこそ　手に入るものを　より　ありがたく　感じられるんだと思います。

key: Living out here, I've learned how many things I've taken for granted,
en: Living out here, I've learned how many things I've taken for granted,
ja: ここで　暮らしてみて　自分が　どれだけ多くのことを　当たり前だと思っていたか　気づかされました

key: And I've also learned how many things I was too used to.
en: And I've also learned how many things I was too used to.
ja: それに　どれだけ多くのことに　慣れすぎていたかも。

key: Being out here, and not having to worry about being yelled at because I didn't clean properly,
en: Being out here, and not having to worry about being yelled at because I didn't clean properly,
ja: ここに　いれば　ちゃんと　掃除できなかったと　どなられる心配も　しなくていいし

key: Or because someone else had a bad day,
en: Or because someone else had a bad day,
ja: 誰かの機嫌が　悪かったせいで　どなられることも

key: Or because I didn't want to kiss someone...
en: Or because I didn't want to kiss someone...
ja: 誰かに　キスしたくなかったから　どなられることも……

key: That's the kind of thing I had resigned to...
en: That's the kind of thing I had resigned to...
ja: そういうことに　あきらめて　慣れてしまっていたんです……

key: But here, I've never felt so free.
en: But here, I've never felt so free.
ja: でも　ここに　いると　こんなに　自由を　感じたことは　ありません。

key: I wouldn't go back for anything.
en: I wouldn't go back for anything.
ja: 何が　あっても　戻る気には　なれません。

key: Please excuse me. I--
en: Please excuse me. I--
ja: 失礼しました。わたし――

key: ...know you.
en: ...know you.
ja: ……あなたを　知ってます。

key: Do you remember me?
en: Do you remember me?
ja: わたしのこと　覚えてますか?

key: But, we fought once before--
en: But, we fought once before--
ja: でも　わたしたち　前に　戦ったことが――

key: At Dr. Connal's Orphanage.
en: At Dr. Connal's Orphanage.
ja: コナル博士の孤児院で。

key: My name is Stephanie.
en: My name is Stephanie.
ja: わたしの名前は　ステファニーです。

key: Well, the others have taken to calling me "Stephoscope" because of this outfit...
en: Well, the others have taken to calling me "Stephoscope" because of this outfit...
ja: まあ　この服装のせいで　みんなに「ステファスコープ」って　呼ばれるように　なっちゃいましたけど……

key: I keep telling them I'm not a doctor myself.
en: I keep telling them I'm not a doctor myself.
ja: わたしは　お医者さんじゃないって　いつも　言ってるんですけど。

key: But you and that girl were pretty impressive.
en: But you and that girl were pretty impressive.
ja: でも　あなたと　あの子は　本当に　すごかったです。

key: It seems that as a result of that incident, the Doctor took a leave of absence from the facility.
en: It seems that as a result of that incident, the Doctor took a leave of absence from the facility.
ja: あの事件の結果　あの先生は　施設を　休職することに　なったみたいです。

key: It's hard to forget an event like that.
en: It's hard to forget an event like that.
ja: あんな出来事　忘れられるものじゃ　ありません。

key: Even so, I didn't expect to see you here.
en: Even so, I didn't expect to see you here.
ja: それにしても　ここで　あなたに　会うとは　思いませんでした。

key: I came here hoping to avoid everyone.
en: I came here hoping to avoid everyone.
ja: みんなを　避けたくて　ここへ　来たんです。

key: The truth is, a while after the Doctor left, we were recruited by Team Meteor.
en: The truth is, a while after the Doctor left, we were recruited by Team Meteor.
ja: 実は　あの先生が　いなくなってしばらくして　わたしたち　メテオ団に　勧誘されたんです。

key: They said we would stop receiving wages if we didn't switch over to working for them.
en: They said we would stop receiving wages if we didn't switch over to working for them.
ja: 彼らのために　働かないなら　給料は　もう出ないって　言われて。

key: Most of us were coerced into working for them.
en: Most of us were coerced into working for them.
ja: ほとんどの人が　無理やり　働かされることに　なりました。

key: I don't even know what happened to the other children.
en: I don't even know what happened to the other children.
ja: 他の子どもたちが　どうなったのかすら　わかりません。

key: But I still refused, even under threat of harm.
en: But I still refused, even under threat of harm.
ja: でも　わたしは　危害を加えると　脅されても　拒否し続けました。

key: When they said they would not let me go, I fled-- and ran here.
en: When they said they would not let me go, I fled-- and ran here.
ja: 逃がさないと　言われたので　逃げ出して――　ここまで　来たんです。

key: I was lucky to find this company and shelter... but it is very difficult compared to my old life.
en: I was lucky to find this company and shelter... but it is very difficult compared to my old life.
ja: 運良く　この仲間と　住まいを　見つけられましたが……　昔の生活と比べると　とても　大変です。

key: I've been researching how we can more effectively grow food in this kind of environment so that we don't struggle so much to get by.
en: I've been researching how we can more effectively grow food in this kind of environment so that we don't struggle so much to get by.
ja: こういう環境でも　もっと効率よく　食料を育てる方法を　研究しています　そうすれば　生活に　あまり　苦労しなくて済むので。

key: But it's hard to adjust to-- these kinds of people, this kind of living...
en: But it's hard to adjust to-- these kinds of people, this kind of living...
ja: でも　こういう人たちや　こういう暮らし方に　慣れるのは　大変で……

key: I don't dare go back to the city though-- not until Team Meteor isn't active anymore.
en: I don't dare go back to the city though-- not until Team Meteor isn't active anymore.
ja: それでも　街には　絶対　戻りません―― メテオ団が　活動しなくなるまでは。

key: Anyway, this has been a surprise... but I should get back to work.
en: Anyway, this has been a surprise... but I should get back to work.
ja: とにかく　驚きました……　でも　仕事に　戻らないと。

key: Not just for my own sake, but I'd like to ensure the others can keep living a free life here too.
en: Not just for my own sake, but I'd like to ensure the others can keep living a free life here too.
ja: 自分のためだけじゃなく　他のみんなも　ここで　自由な暮らしを　続けられるように　したいんです。

key: STEPHOSCOPE: Frankly, trying to get anything to grow with so little water is unreasonable.
en: STEPHOSCOPE: Frankly, trying to get anything to grow with so little water is unreasonable.
ja: ステファスコープ: 正直　こんなに水が少ない状態で　何かを育てようなんて　無理な話です。

key: That's the main problem.
en: That's the main problem.
ja: それが　一番の問題で。

key: We sometimes have water brought to us, and we can sometimes luck into it at a mirage, but neither of those are really reliable.
en: We sometimes have water brought to us, and we can sometimes luck into it at a mirage, but neither of those are really reliable.
ja: 時々　水を　運んできてもらったり　しんきろうで　運良く　見つけたり　しますが　どちらも　あてには　できません。

key: If we could find even just a single consistent water source in this desert, we'd probably be just fine.
en: If we could find even just a single consistent water source in this desert, we'd probably be just fine.
ja: この砂漠に　安定した水源が　一つでも　見つかれば　きっと　何とか　なるはずです。

key: I gather from your increasingly scuffed attire you've been traveling around a lot?
en: I gather from your increasingly scuffed attire you've been traveling around a lot?
ja: どんどん　傷んでいく服装から　察するに　あちこち　旅を　してるんですよね?

key: Should you happen to find anywhere in this desert where there might be some kind of water source, please tell me immediately.
en: Should you happen to find anywhere in this desert where there might be some kind of water source, please tell me immediately.
ja: もし　この砂漠で　水源らしきものを　見つけたら　すぐに　教えてください。

key: You've already seen one? Really? Tell me where!
en: You've already seen one? Really? Tell me where!
ja: もう　見つけたんですか? 本当に? どこか　教えてください!

key: In the cave to the west...
en: In the cave to the west...
ja: 西の洞窟に……

key: Those must be the Teknite Mountains?
en: Those must be the Teknite Mountains?
ja: それって　テクナイト山脈の　ことですよね?

key: But that's not far at all! This could be huge!
en: But that's not far at all! This could be huge!
ja: それなら　全然　遠くないです! これは　すごいことに　なるかも!

key: I'll start reassessing my options right away.
en: I'll start reassessing my options right away.
ja: さっそく　選択肢を　見直します。

key: Thank you very much.
en: Thank you very much.
ja: 本当に　ありがとうございます。

key: Hmm... As a token of thanks, please take this stone.
en: Hmm... As a token of thanks, please take this stone.
ja: うーん……　お礼に　この石を　受け取ってください。

key: I'm not sure what its properties are, but I found it while I was out looking myself before.
en: I'm not sure what its properties are, but I found it while I was out looking myself before.
ja: どんな性質のものかは　わかりませんが　前に　自分で　探しているときに　見つけたものです。

key: STEPHOSCOPE: There may just be enduring hope for us yet...
en: STEPHOSCOPE: There may just be enduring hope for us yet...
ja: ステファスコープ: まだ　わたしたちに　希望が　残っているのかも　しれません……

key: I'll keep searching as well.
en: I'll keep searching as well.
ja: わたしも　探し続けます。

key: STEPHOSCOPE: I don't suppose you've had any luck finding a water source?
en: STEPHOSCOPE: I don't suppose you've had any luck finding a water source?
ja: ステファスコープ: 水源　見つけられました?

key: You've found one? Really? Tell me where!
en: You've found one? Really? Tell me where!
ja: もう　見つけたんですか? 本当に? どこか　教えてください!

key: Well, it's only to be expected in a place like this.
en: Well, it's only to be expected in a place like this.
ja: まあ　こんな場所ですから　仕方ないですよね。

key: For all we know, there may not be one at all.
en: For all we know, there may not be one at all.
ja: もしかしたら　そもそも　存在しないのかも　しれませんし。

key: But I'll keep looking.
en: But I'll keep looking.
ja: でも　探し続けます。

key: STEPHOSCOPE: Thanks again for your help with the water stuff.
en: STEPHOSCOPE: Thanks again for your help with the water stuff.
ja: ステファスコープ: 水のこと　あらためて　ありがとうございました。

key: Hmm... As a token, please take this stone.
en: Hmm... As a token, please take this stone.
ja: うーん……　これも　お礼に　受け取ってください。

key: STEPHOSCOPE: This opens up so many opportunities.
en: STEPHOSCOPE: This opens up so many opportunities.
ja: ステファスコープ: これで　いろんな可能性が　開けます。

key: Now I've got to explore what would be the most efficient things to grow, what arrangements, and how we can use them...
en: Now I've got to explore what would be the most efficient things to grow, what arrangements, and how we can use them...
ja: これから　何を育てるのが　一番効率がいいか　どう配置するか　どう活用するか　考えないと……

key: Oh! And how do we handle distribution while minimizing evaporation from the heat?
en: Oh! And how do we handle distribution while minimizing evaporation from the heat?
ja: あ! それに　熱による蒸発を　最小限に抑えながら　どう分配するかも!

key: Lots to do-- but I'll definitely figure it out, thanks to you.
en: Lots to do-- but I'll definitely figure it out, thanks to you.
ja: やることは　山ほどありますが―― あなたのおかげで　きっと　うまく　やり遂げます。

key: TAKA: Well, this is perfect.
en: TAKA: Well, this is perfect.
ja: タカ: いいですね　ここ　完璧です。

key: EUROPA: Y'all like it?
en: EUROPA: Y'all like it?
ja: エウロパ: 気に入ったかい?

key: TAKA: Yeah.
en: TAKA: Yeah.
ja: タカ: ええ。

key: This is me.
en: This is me.
ja: ここが　僕の部屋　ってわけですね。

key: EUROPA: Then it's all yours!
en: EUROPA: Then it's all yours!
ja: エウロパ: なら　あんたのもんだ!

key: Feel free to clean up or redecorate however you like.
en: Feel free to clean up or redecorate however you like.
ja: 好きに　掃除したり　模様替えしたり　して　いいからね。

key: And if you need anything, you just let me or one of the others know and we'll see what we can do for you.
en: And if you need anything, you just let me or one of the others know and we'll see what we can do for you.
ja: それと　何か　必要なら　あたしか　誰かに　声を　かけとくれ　できる限りのことは　するからさ。

key: I imagine y'all are mighty tired, but when you feel up to it, come out and introduce yourselves to the rest of the folk here.
en: I imagine y'all are mighty tired, but when you feel up to it, come out and introduce yourselves to the rest of the folk here.
ja: かなり　疲れてるとは　思うけど　落ち着いたら　みんなに　あいさつしに　出ておいでよ。

key: Everyone's always excited to meet a new friend!
en: Everyone's always excited to meet a new friend!
ja: みんな　新しい仲間に会えるのを　いつも　楽しみに　してるからね!

key: Until then I'll leave you be.
en: Until then I'll leave you be.
ja: それまでは　そっとしておくよ。

key: TAKA: Maybe I'll take her up on that...
en: TAKA: Maybe I'll take her up on that...
ja: タカ: その言葉に　甘えようかな……

key: Sleep is sounding pretty swell right now.
en: Sleep is sounding pretty swell right now.
ja: 今は　眠るのが　最高に　良さそうに　聞こえます。

key: \PN, thanks for bringing me here.
en: \PN, thanks for bringing me here.
ja: \PN　ここに　連れてきてくれて　ありがとうございます。

key: I feel like, maybe things will be okay.
en: I feel like, maybe things will be okay.
ja: なんだか　きっと　大丈夫な気が　してきました。

key: I guess I'm gonna take a nap, and then...
en: I guess I'm gonna take a nap, and then...
ja: ちょっと　昼寝して　それから……

key: Let's talk more later, okay?
en: Let's talk more later, okay?
ja: あとで　もっと　話しましょう　いいですか?

key: TAKA: Mmm... \PN?
en: TAKA: Mmm... \PN?
ja: タカ: うーん……\PN?

key: You're not going too far, right?
en: You're not going too far, right?
ja: あんまり　遠くには　行かないですよね?

key: I feel like...
en: I feel like...
ja: なんだか……

key: Maybe I could sleep better if you're near by...
en: Maybe I could sleep better if you're near by...
ja: あなたが　近くに　いてくれたほうが　よく　眠れる気が　します……

key: TAKA: I don't know if I'll really be able to sleep,
en: TAKA: I don't know if I'll really be able to sleep,
ja: タカ: 本当に　眠れるかは　わかりませんけど

key: But I sure need to try anyway.
en: But I sure need to try anyway.
ja: とにかく　試してみないと　いけませんね。

key: Locked.
en: Locked.
ja: カギが　かかっている

key: BOUFFALANT BILL: Yipes, partner!
en: BOUFFALANT BILL: Yipes, partner!
ja: バッフロンビル: おおっと　相棒!

key: I didn't see you come in even a bit.
en: I didn't see you come in even a bit.
ja: 入ってきたの　全然　気づかなかったぜ。

key: Gosh, the ol' back alley she built in here is a real spooker.
en: Gosh, the ol' back alley she built in here is a real spooker.
ja: まったく　あの女が　作った裏路地は　本当に　不気味だな。

key: ???: Yipes, stranger!
en: ???: Yipes, stranger!
ja: ???: おおっと　見ない顔だな!

key: How you get in here?!
en: How you get in here?!
ja: どうやって　ここに　入ったんだ?!

key: And what you doin' anyway?
en: And what you doin' anyway?
ja: ってか　何を　してるんだ?

key: Ain' often I see folks around these parts from her Gym, much less if I ain' met them before.
en: Ain' often I see folks around these parts from her Gym, much less if I ain' met them before.
ja: 彼女のジムから　この辺に　やつが　来るのなんて　めったに　ないし　しかも　会ったこともないやつなら　なおさらだ。

key: I'd swear you was a thief, but there ain' nothin' here to steal.
en: I'd swear you was a thief, but there ain' nothin' here to steal.
ja: てっきり　泥棒かと　思ったが　ここには　盗むもんなんて　何もねぇ。

key: The name's Bouffalant Bill.
en: The name's Bouffalant Bill.
ja: 名前は　バッフロンビルだ。

key: Please to make your 'quaintances, but maybe try the front door next time before you give a fella a heart attack.
en: Please to make your 'quaintances, but maybe try the front door next time before you give a fella a heart attack.
ja: よろしくな　だが　次は　正面玄関から　来てくれや　心臓に　悪いからよ。

key: "Aldie--
en: "Aldie--
ja: 「アルディ――

key: What in the great shifting sands have I told you about messing around with these magickal gizmos and whatnot?
en: What in the great shifting sands have I told you about messing around with these magickal gizmos and whatnot?
ja: こんな魔法じみたガラクタを　いじくり回すなって　いったい　何回　言ったと　思ってんのさ?

key: Miss Percy came at me all a-holler about mirrored walls that and golden beams this.
en: Miss Percy came at me all a-holler about mirrored walls that and golden beams this.
ja: パーシーさんが　鏡の壁がどうの　金色の光線がどうのって　大騒ぎして　あたしんとこに　来たのよ。

key: I thought she had just skimmed off of Bill's stash again,
en: I thought she had just skimmed off of Bill's stash again,
ja: また　ビルの隠し酒でも　くすねたのかと　思ったんだけど

key: But after 20 full minutes of protesting, she finally convinced me to take a look.
en: But after 20 full minutes of protesting, she finally convinced me to take a look.
ja: 丸20分　抗議されて　やっと　見に行くことに　したのよ。

key: And lo and behold there is lord-above-knows-what just built into our car now?!
en: And lo and behold there is lord-above-knows-what just built into our car now?!
ja: そしたら　なんと　うちの車両に　訳のわかんないものが　組みこまれてるじゃないの?!

key: I dunno what this is, but get it out, stat!"
en: I dunno what this is, but get it out, stat!"
ja: これが　何なのか　知らないけど　今すぐ　どけて!」
